blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 156 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug df94-66ba-dbf8-4ac1 has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix this large is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan df94-66ba-dbf8-4ac1` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review df94-66ba-dbf8-4ac1` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan df94-66ba-dbf8-4ac1 --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
